## Problem

What limitation or use case motivates the proposal?

## Proposed change

Describe the intended behavior and why it belongs in this project.

## Alternatives

What simpler options have you considered?

## Scope and safety

Explain effects on USB observation, the disposable demo, systemd/udev, privileges, recovery, resource use or dependencies. Do not assume support for arbitrary services or cryptographic authentication.

## Validation

How could the change be tested safely without touching essential services or requiring physical USB hardware?

## Additional context

A proposal is not a commitment to implementation or merge.
